normie.tagline: An everyday word, fingerspelled. Read the hands, guess the word.
normie.quip: Talk to the hand. Then read it.
normie.helpQuip: Watch the vowels: they’re the fingertips.
help: Watch today’s everyday word fingerspelled one letter at a time in the two-handed alphabet used in Auslan, BSL and NZSL. Normie mode: no medicine.
The dots show how many letters. Replay as often as you like.
Type the word. You get three tries; letters turn green (right spot) or yellow (in the word, wrong spot).
Wrong guess one unlocks a clue. Wrong guess two unlocks step mode: go letter by letter at your own pace.
Difficulty rises through the week: short and slow on Monday, long and fast on Sunday. Stuck? Open Learn the alphabet.
A new word arrives at midnight, Sydney time. Every answer links to Auslan Signbank so you can see the real sign.
